findings.title: Empty catch swallows fetch/JSON errors in getJson
findings.note: Catch block is completely empty: network failures, non-JSON responses, and auth errors are silently discarded. Caller receives null indistinguishable from a legitimate empty result; no log, no rethrow, nothing to alert anyone the request failed.

findings.title: Admin request failures logged then converted to null, hiding cause from caller
findings.note: Error is logged with cause preserved in the console, but is not rethrown or surfaced to the caller; getAdminJson returns null on both failure and any falsy JSON body, so callers cannot distinguish failure from a valid null/empty response.

not_assessed: Whether any test suite exercises these catch paths (test coverage not assessed)
Whether console.error in client-admin.ts is captured by any monitoring/alerting downstream
